subject: centering cells within a call to renderGvis from the GoogleVis package

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: centering cells within a call to renderGvis from the GoogleVis package
parts:
Dear all,

I have a simple shiny app that calls renderGvis from the GoogleVis package, to display a data table.

By default the cells are right-aligned. I'd like to center them.

The following intuitive syntax doesn't work:

output$data <- renderGvis({
  gvisTable(Data()$df, options = list('align'="center"))
})

The following setting in my ui.R should work:

tags$head(
  tags$style(type='text/css'
    , ".google-visualization-table-td-number {text-align: center;}"
  )
)

but it doesn't. Using "inspect element" I find that the following setting from table.css overrides my custom setting :

.google-visualization-table-td-number {
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

I can change right to center using the "inspect element" tool of the browser, but I can't control it within shiny.

Any suggestions?

Many thanks.

messages.author: 19d7e0c9654d809e
messages.subject: Re: centering cells within a call to renderGvis from the GoogleVis package
parts:
gvisTable doesn't look like it supports an align option through the Shiny interface. I just recently learned through another post in this group how to do some customization to a gvisTable through css. 

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/UCqfb2ocaEE

For your case, in ui.R try using:

tags$style(type="text/css", HTML("#data td { text-align: center}")), htmlOutput("data")
